answer: Each newcomer plants one lotus stake of 8 POA in a public lagoon pool shared by every identity its wallet funds, drained by karst sinkholes at n-squared litres per epoch, n the wallet's identity count, so the pool level falls faster the more clones draw from it; the level is published on a public board each epoch. Every identity must refill its share with one fresh live job, re-run by a stranger staking 3 POA, or the lagoon runs dry, freezing the whole wallet and slashing every bond. The nth clone posts 8n-squared POA: 1st 8, 10th 800, 3,080 across ten.
